cases.expectation: AppModule imports AuthModule, AuditModule, and NotesModule; provides NotesService; and declares NotesController.
mustNotEmit: Provider edge derived from a display-name-only match

cases.expectation: AuthGuard is a proven application-global guard through the @nestjs/core APP_GUARD token and useClass.
AuditGuard is a proven application-global guard through useExisting and its provider declaration.
The direct forwardRef callback resolves AppModule without executing the callback.
The uniquely bound Nest application registers AuthGuard then AuditGuard globally.
A local string containing APP_GUARD does not register a global guard.
A conditional useClass target preserves both candidates or an explicit ambiguous registration.
Function-produced providers and APP_GUARD useFactory make global completeness unknown.
DynamicModule.forRoot is inventoried as an unsupported import without execution.
An application instance escaping to an unknown callback prevents proof of complete bootstrap guard registration.
